editorial:
Imagine a world where the church has to start training new exorcists because demons are popping up everywhere. That is where you meet Sister Ann, a young nun who is way more capable than the men around her. She teams up with Father Dante, and together they try to save a young girl from a nasty spirit. The vibe is very dark and tense, making you feel like something bad is always lurking just around the corner. It is a cool spin on the usual priest-versus-demon story because it puts a woman in the lead role during a time when that was not common.

You will notice that the acting is solid, and the jump scares are timed well enough to keep you on edge. While the plot follows a few old tropes, the pacing stays quick so you never get bored. If you love movies about possessions and secret battles, you should definitely give this a try.
endingExplained: In the end, you find out that the demon was playing a long game to get inside Sister Ann. During the final fight, the demon tries to trick her into letting it take over her body. However, Ann uses her strong faith and a clever trick to trap the demon instead. She manages to cast the evil spirit out for good, saving the girl and herself, though she is left scarred by the experience.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves scary movies about demons and the church.
